mechanism: Efavirenz induces CYP3A4 and other metabolic pathways, potentially reducing minocycline levels, while minocycline may increase CNS penetration of efavirenz; additive CNS effects are possible.
action: Monitor clinical efficacy of both agents; consider alternative tetracycline or increased minocycline dosing if needed; counsel on additive CNS effects (dizziness, difficulty concentrating).
